traffic_comparison.interpretation: Orders labeled Jam have longer average delivery times than orders labeled Low. This is observational and does not establish causation.

data_quality.handling: Retain as unknown and disclose in reporting.

limitations: Traffic category is strongly associated with order hour.
Estimated distance is straight-line distance, not road distance.
The 30-minute threshold is an analytical choice, not a verified SLA.
Results describe this dataset and may not generalize to live operations.
